hero.badge: Empowering You to Stay Safe Online & Offline
hero.title: Learn Open Source Intelligence, AI Literacy & Digital Safety.
hero.description: ASOSINT is a free, open-source educational platform by Axomiya IT Labs helping everyone learn OSINT, AI literacy, cybersecurity, digital privacy and fact-checking.

trust.heading: Why Digital Literacy Matters
trust.description: The internet is changing faster than ever. Learn the essential skills every modern internet user should have.

ai.title: AI Isn't Always Right
ai.description: AI can confidently generate false information, fake references, hallucinations and incorrect answers. Always verify important information before trusting or sharing it.

deepfake.title: Deepfakes Are Becoming More Realistic
deepfake.description: AI can create realistic faces, voices and videos that never existed. Learn how to recognize manipulated media before it deceives you.

engineering.title: Hackers Target People First
engineering.description: Most cyber attacks begin with phishing, impersonation and social engineering rather than sophisticated hacking. Awareness is your strongest defense.

osint.title: Think Like an Investigator
osint.description: Learn how to verify information, identify fake profiles, analyze images and investigate digital evidence using OSINT techniques.

highlight.heading: Stay Safe in the AI Era
highlight.description: Understand the risks of AI, misinformation and cybercrime before it's too late.

ai-warning.title: AI Safety Warning
ai-warning.text: Artificial Intelligence can generate convincing but false information, fake references, fabricated images, cloned voices and deepfake videos. Never trust AI blindly. Always verify important information before making decisions or sharing it online.

cyber-safety.title: Cybersecurity Starts With Awareness
cyber-safety.text: Most cyber attacks don't begin with sophisticated hacking—they begin with deception. Phishing, fake websites, social engineering and weak passwords cause most successful attacks. Learn how attackers think so you can stay protected.
